art_direction: 栗棕卷发女性坐在港口石凳上写生，薄荷绿连衣裙与暖陶色建筑形成柔和对比。
composition_variation: Paint an original high-end anime scene of a 29-year-old woman enjoying a sketchbook beside a small terracotta harbor. Her attractive mature face has deep amber eyes, a refined nose bridge, softly arched eyebrows, faint freckles, and a composed smile that conveys quiet creative confidence. Chestnut waves touch her shoulders, with one side tucked behind a small gold stud earring. Her clothing is an opaque mint-green linen midi dress with short loose sleeves, a modest square neckline, a natural waist, and flat cream espadrilles. She sits upright on a low stone bench with both feet resting comfortably on the paving, her knees together at a natural angle. A sketchbook rests on her lap; one hand steadies its corner while the other holds a pencil just above the page. Show only loose abstract marks, never readable lettering. Behind her, moored boats become soft geometric shapes beneath peach and faded rust buildings. Late-afternoon sunshine warms her skin and the bench while cool water reflections balance the lower scene. Emphasize graceful posture, crisp facial drawing, and believable relaxed hands. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
